```{=html}
<h2 class="nm-card-h nm-card-h-lg">Work with us</h2>
```

We welcome students, residents and postdocs interested in neuromuscular disease. Use the application form to tell us about yourself and what you would like to work on, and we will get back to you.

Add a link to your CV (for example Google Drive, Dropbox or LinkedIn). The form is hosted by Google Forms and needs no Google account.

```{=html}
<h3 class="nm-card-h">Open positions</h3>
```

There are no open positions listed at the moment. Theses, internships and fellowships can be discussed at any time through the application form.
